✅ API call confirmed: omit(node.data, 'marks') in slateRemark.js. However, the keys are static string literals ('marks'), which specifically prevents attacker-controlled prototype pollution. Satisfies version but not reachable constraints.

✅ API call confirmed: minimatch(path, pattern, ...) in netlify-lfs-client.ts. Patterns are sourced from the CMS configuration (config.yml). An attacker with configuration access can trigger ReDoS via malicious glob patterns.

✅ API call confirmed: Local Git LFS clients use minimatch for glob pattern verification. Malicious patterns in config.yml can lead to DoS.
✅ API call confirmed: Patterns are matched using minimatch in the Git Gateway backend client. Subject to user-controlled path matching patterns.
